description: Unclassified balance-sheet presentation for savings institutions (SIC 6035 and 6036). The supplied CFFN reference presentation PDF guides presentation only. All 179 supplied unique US-GAAP concepts are retained exactly once; filing-specific presentation, measurement and consolidation require review.
classification_notes: The supplied 179-concept list defines this profile’s universe; occurrence thresholds and applicability to every savings institution have not been independently established.
reference presentation rows with no supplied concept are not invented. Hierarchy is presentation only; total nodes do not specify calculations and adjacent concepts are not necessarily equivalent.
Use matching instrument, accrued-interest, allowance, maturity, dimension and consolidation scopes when selecting facts. Missing facts are not zero.

Credit allowances, accumulated depreciation/amortization, treasury stock and unearned employee equity deductions are marked contra. Actual signs and mixed premium/discount adjustments require filing context.

Fair-value disclosures, securities cost/allowance bridges, contractual debt terms and nonmonetary share/per-share facts are supplementary. Primary carrying balances and supplementary measurements must not be summed.

metadata_contract.node_kind: Only group, total and line_item; total covers totals and subtotals and never implies arithmetic.
metadata_contract.period_type: Official 2026 taxonomy periodType; historical facts retain their own taxonomy context.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Official taxonomy type mapped to monetary, shares, per_share, percent or ratio.
metadata_contract.contra: Intrinsic deduction indicator; it does not prescribe an arithmetic operation or the sign of a source fact.
metadata_contract.review_reason: Concept-specific uncertainty or measurement limitation; shared cautions belong in group classification_note.

taxonomy_reference.note: Period and unit metadata verified against the 2026 schema. Historical filings must still use their own taxonomy versions and fact units.

children.label: Cash, Due from Banks and Bank Deposits
children.classification_note: Cash totals, components and interest-bearing placements overlap; these concepts are not equivalent and must not be summed automatically.

children.label: Cash And Cash Equivalents At Carrying Value
Certificates Of Deposit At Carrying Value
Interbank Placements and Reverse Repos
children.classification_note: Combined balances overlap individual federal funds and reverse repo balances.

children.label: Investment Securities and Trading Assets
children.classification_note: The reference guides presentation order; AFS/HTM/trading accounting classifications are retained. Investment totals overlap detailed categories. Interbank placements and reverse repos are presented separately.

children.label: Investment and Securities Totals
children.classification_note: Investment aggregates and the combined AFS/HTM balance overlap individual portfolios and may use different measurement bases; do not sum these alternatives.

children.label: Combined AFS and HTM Debt Securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturity
concepts.review_reason: Combines available-for-sale and held-to-maturity portfolios measured on different bases; do not add to either portfolio balance.

children.label: Trading Securities
children.classification_note: Trading securities remain separate from AFS, HTM and nontrading equity investments.

children.label: Available-for-Sale Debt Securities
children.classification_note: Carrying-value concepts remain separate from amortized-cost and allowance disclosures.

children.label: Available For Sale Securities Debt Securities
Debt Securities Available For Sale Excluding Accrued Interest
Held-to-Maturity Debt Securities
children.classification_note: HTM carrying balances are amortized-cost measures. Legacy, after-allowance and accrued-interest-excluding concepts may describe overlapping portfolios.

children.label: HTM Debt Securities after Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
HTM Debt Securities — Amortized Cost after Allowance
Equity Securities
children.classification_note: Fair-value-through-net-income equity balances with and without explicit current/noncurrent scope are alternatives; confirm scope before selecting.

children.label: Equity Securities FV-NI Current And Noncurrent
Other Investments and Restricted Bank Stock
children.classification_note: Other and restricted investment aggregates can contain FHLB/FRB stock. The combined bank-stock amount overlaps the individual FHLB and FRB holdings.

children.label: Other Investments And Securities At Cost
Federal Home Loan Bank Stock And Federal Reserve Bank Stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Maturity-based investment aggregate can include securities or deposits classified elsewhere; confirm its instrument scope before displaying separately.

children.label: Loans and Leases, Net
children.classification_note: Gross, net, fee-adjusted and accrued-interest-excluding balances are separate measurements. Allowances are contra-assets; do not assume the source fact is negative or apply a sign solely from this hierarchy.

children.label: Net Loan Balances
children.classification_note: Net financing receivables and net notes receivable may cover overlapping portfolios; accrued-interest treatment and instrument scope must match.

children.label: Loans after Credit Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
Gross Loans and Carrying-Value Adjustments
children.classification_note: Gross measurements, product subsets and signed loan adjustments are separated below; they are not parallel additive balances.

children.label: Gross Loan Measurements
children.classification_note: Before-allowance amounts differ in treatment of fees, accrued interest and loans in process; select the matching scope rather than adding alternative balances.

children.label: Loans before Credit Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
Loans before Allowance, Fees and Loans in Process, Excluding Interest
Loans before Credit Allowance and Fees
Loan Product Details
children.classification_note: Loan-type balances are subsets of broader receivable totals, not additional asset categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage-loan category is a subset of financing receivables; verify gross/net basis and dimensions before comparing with loan totals.

children.label: Loan Carrying Adjustments
children.classification_note: Origination fees/costs and purchase premiums/discounts have distinct scopes and signed effects. Do not apply a uniform deduction or add them to an already adjusted carrying value.

children.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment / Origination Fees and Premiums / Discounts

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableUnamortizedPurchasePremiumDiscount
concepts.review_reason: Purchase premiums and discounts adjust loan carrying amounts; the direction of the adjustment depends on whether the fact is a premium or discount.

children.label: Loan Credit Loss Allowances
children.classification_note: General and accrued-interest-excluding financing allowances can overlap. Match the allowance to its gross loan balance; do not deduct from an already net balance.

children.label: Loan Credit Loss Allowance
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

children.label: Loan Credit Loss Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

children.label: Other Asset Categories
children.classification_note: These presentation categories can be embedded in issuer other-asset totals. Inclusion in this group does not establish arithmetic or separate face-statement presentation.

children.label: Loans Held for Sale
children.classification_note: Held-for-sale loan balances differ in netting and disposal-group scope; keep the separate fair-value disclosures outside primary asset balances.

children.label: Loans Receivable Held For Sale Net Not Part Of Disposal Group
Loans Receivable Held For Sale Amount
Investments in Unconsolidated Entities
children.classification_note: Equity-method investments are distinct from consolidated subsidiaries and fair-value equity securities.

children.label: Real Estate and Foreclosed Assets
children.classification_note: Real-estate-only and broader foreclosed-asset amounts are overlapping scopes; do not add a subset to its encompassing total.

children.label: Other Real Estate And Foreclosed Assets
Property, Equipment and Lease Assets
children.classification_note: Net owned property and leased right-of-use assets are distinct categories; verify whether an issuer embeds right-of-use assets in another reported asset line.

children.label: Operating Lease Right Of Use Asset
Finance Lease Right Of Use Asset
Interest and Other Receivables
children.classification_note: Investment income may be a subset of interest receivable. The doubtful-account allowance relates to its gross receivable scope and is already reflected in a matching net amount.

children.label: Allowance For Doubtful Accounts Receivable
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

children.label: Deferred Tax Assets
children.classification_note: Net deferred tax assets reflect the applicable valuation allowance and tax netting rules. The valuation allowance is retained as detail, not an additional asset.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance
concepts.review_reason: Deduction from deferred tax assets before the allowance; do not subtract it again from DeferredIncomeTaxAssetsNet.

children.label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets
children.classification_note: Intangibles including goodwill overlap goodwill and other intangible components; alternative net intangible scopes are not additive.

children.label: Servicing Assets
children.classification_note: Total servicing assets can include both fair-value and amortized-value components; alternative measurement bases are retained separately.

children.label: Servicing Asset At Fair Value Amount
Bank-Owned Life Insurance
children.classification_note: Bank-owned life insurance and cash surrender value can describe overlapping policy holdings; verify valuation and policy scope.

children.label: Cash Surrender Value Of Life Insurance
Derivative Assets
children.classification_note: Recognized derivative assets require issuer netting and collateral context; do not offset automatically against derivative liabilities.

children.label: Other Assets and Prepayments
children.classification_note: OtherAssets and combined prepaid/interest-receivable aggregates can encompass individually reported balances; resolve issuer presentation before selecting lines.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestReceivableAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Combined interest receivable and other assets can include the separately reported InterestReceivable balance; resolve inclusions before displaying both.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Combines prepaid expenses with other assets and may overlap both separately reported prepaid expenses and the OtherAssets aggregate.

children.label: Assets Held for Sale and Disposal Groups
children.classification_note: Disposal-group assets and assets held for sale outside disposal groups have different scope; avoid reusing underlying asset balances.

children.label: Assets Of Disposal Group Including Discontinued Operation
Assets Held For Sale Not Part Of Disposal Group
Interest-Bearing and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits
children.classification_note: Domestic location and interest-bearing status are overlapping axes. Domestic totals may be subsets of all-office totals; select a consistent partition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepositsDomestic
concepts.review_reason: Domestic deposit aggregate spans interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing products; it overlaps the domestic subtotals and may exclude foreign-office deposits.

children.label: Demand and Checking Deposits
children.classification_note: Demand, checking and NOW concepts can overlap. NOW deposits also overlap combined money-market/NOW disclosures elsewhere.

children.label: Savings, Money Market and Time Deposits
children.classification_note: Savings, money-market, NOW, time-deposit and certificate balances may overlap; the combined money-market/NOW total is not additive with either component.

children.label: Deposit Size and Brokered Deposit Details
children.classification_note: Size, insurance threshold, brokered status and product type are overlapping classification axes, not additive categories.

children.label: Time Deposits At Or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
Uninsured US Time Deposits above Insurance Limit

concepts.name: us-gaap:TimeDepositLiabilityAboveUsInsuranceLimit
concepts.review_reason: Measures the uninsured amount above the applicable insurance limit, unlike the entire balances of accounts at or above a threshold; these two measures are not interchangeable.

children.label: Borrowings
children.classification_note: Structural presentation group without an invented borrowing total. Instrument type and maturity are different axes; combined debt balances overlap component categories.

children.label: Short-Term Borrowings
children.classification_note: Short-term borrowing totals overlap detailed short-term balances. Repo-specific and combined federal funds/repo balances are adjacent under Borrowings with maturity left unspecified.

children.label: Long-Term Debt
children.classification_note: LongTermDebt must not be assumed to exclude current maturities; only explicitly noncurrent concepts identify that scope.

children.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
children.classification_note: Total advances overlap long-term advances. Branch and maturity breakdowns and pledged collateral remain supplementary; no unspecified balance is assumed current or noncurrent.

children.label: Advances From Federal Home Loan Banks
Federal Home Loan Bank Advances Long Term
Subordinated Debt
children.classification_note: Junior subordinated notes can be a subset of subordinated debt and of broader long-term debt totals.

children.label: Other Debt and Combined Borrowing Balances
children.classification_note: Debt type and maturity are overlapping axes; do not infer short- or long-term classification from unspecified concepts.

children.label: Debt Longterm And Shortterm Combined Amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
concepts.review_reason: Combined debt and finance/capital lease obligations may already include separately reported lease liabilities and other debt balances.

children.label: Lease Liabilities
children.classification_note: Total lease liabilities have unspecified maturity; do not classify the entire balance as long term.

children.label: Repurchase Agreement Borrowings
children.classification_note: Repo borrowing balances overlap and have unspecified maturity; use contractual context before allocating to short- or long-term borrowings.

children.label: Securities Sold Under Agreements To Repurchase
Provisions and Other Liabilities
children.classification_note: Pension-only and pension-plus-postretirement liabilities overlap; current deferred compensation is a subset of current/noncurrent compensation liabilities.

children.label: Off Balance Sheet Credit Loss Liability
Pension and Other Postretirement Plan Liabilities
Deferred Compensation Liability Current And Noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current portion only; may be included in DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndNoncurrent and must not be added to that total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPensionPlanCurrentAndNoncurrentLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Pension-only liability may be included in the broader pension and other postretirement plans liability; confirm plan and consolidation scope.

children.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities
children.classification_note: Net deferred tax liabilities are subject to applicable jurisdictional netting; do not mechanically offset against net deferred tax assets.

children.label: Other Liabilities
children.classification_note: Accrued and other-liability aggregates can include interest payable, borrower escrow advances and separately classified liabilities; do not add without resolving inclusions.

children.label: Accounts Payable And Accrued Liabilities Current And Noncurrent
Borrower Advances for Taxes and Insurance
Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
Derivative Liabilities
children.classification_note: Recognized derivative liabilities require issuer netting and collateral context; do not offset automatically against derivative assets.

children.label: Disposal Group Liabilities
children.classification_note: Disposal-group liabilities may encompass underlying liability categories; avoid counting them again elsewhere.

children.label: Liabilities Of Disposal Group Including Discontinued Operation
Common Equity
children.classification_note: Presentation grouping of common-equity components, not an invented reported subtotal. Trust stock and employee equity adjustments require filing-specific sign and classification.

children.label: Common Stock
children.classification_note: Common stock value and value outstanding are alternative scopes; neither is automatically equal to par value multiplied by outstanding shares.

children.label: Additional Paid-in Capital
children.classification_note: Common-stock APIC can be included in total additional paid-in capital; the two measures are not additive.

children.label: Additional Paid In Capital Common Stock
Retained Earnings
children.classification_note: Retained earnings or accumulated deficit is a signed equity balance, not current-period net income.

children.label: AOCI — AFS Securities, Net of Tax
AOCI — Pension and Postretirement Plans, Net of Tax
Treasury Stock
children.classification_note: Total and common treasury-stock values may overlap; both are equity deductions with source-sign handling required.

children.label: Treasury Stock Value
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

children.label: Treasury Stock Common Value
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

children.label: ESOP, Trust Stock and Deferred Compensation Equity
children.classification_note: Unearned employee shares, stock held in trust and deferred compensation equity are distinct equity adjustments. Verify recognition and sign in the filing; ESOP suspense share counts are supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnearnedESOPShares
concepts.review_reason: Taxonomy defines a monetary fair value of unearned ESOP shares, not a share count; confirm the issuer’s equity deduction and measurement basis.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockHeldInTrust
concepts.review_reason: Monetary value of stock held in trust; confirm the trust arrangement and whether the issuer presents it as an equity deduction before assigning a sign.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCompensationEquity
concepts.review_reason: Unearned portion of stock issued under share-based plans; distinguish this equity deduction from a deferred compensation liability.

children.label: Preferred Stock, Carrying Value
children.classification_note: Preferred-stock carrying amounts may require permanent equity, temporary equity or liability classification depending on redemption terms; per-share liquidation preferences remain supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValue
concepts.review_reason: Total preferred-stock carrying amount requires redemption-term review before permanent-equity placement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred-stock carrying amount can differ from total issued preferred stock; confirm outstanding scope and redemption classification.

nodes.label: Liabilities And Stockholders Equity
nodes.classification_note: Reported combined liabilities and equity total. Reconcile its filing-specific scope, including temporary equity where applicable; do not derive it by summing presentation children.

nodes.label: Supplementary Disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Disclosure classifications do not imply a separately recognized balance-sheet line item. Fair values, gross exposures, share counts and contractual amounts must not be summed with carrying values.

children.label: Fair Value Disclosures
children.classification_note: Fair values of HTM securities, loans and the AFS mortgage-backed subset are disclosure measurements, not incremental carrying-value assets.

children.label: Held To Maturity Securities Fair Value

concepts.name: us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesFairValue
concepts.review_reason: HTM fair value is a disclosure valuation rather than amortized-cost carrying value.

children.label: Loans Held For Sale Fair Value Disclosure

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Fair value disclosed for held-for-sale loans is not automatically the recognized amount of those loans.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansReceivableFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Disclosed loan fair value differs from the amortized-cost loan carrying balance and is not an additional loan asset.

children.label: AFS Mortgage-Backed Securities — Fair Value Disclosure

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageBackedSecuritiesAvailableForSaleFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Fair value of the mortgage-backed subset of AFS securities; overlaps total AFS debt securities rather than representing an additional asset.

children.label: Securities Amortized Cost, Allowances and Restricted Balances
children.classification_note: Separate AFS and HTM gross/net cost and credit-allowance measurements; reconcile only matching portfolios and accrued-interest scopes.

children.label: AFS Amortized-Cost Measurements
children.classification_note: AFS cost before/after allowance and accrued-interest inclusion differ; these are alternative measurement disclosures, not additions to fair-value assets.

children.label: Available For Sale Debt Securities Amortized Cost Basis

concepts.name: us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAmortizedCostBasis
concepts.review_reason: AFS amortized cost basis is distinct from the fair-value carrying amount and from cost measures after credit allowance.

children.label: AFS Debt — Cost before Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: Gross AFS amortized cost explicitly excludes accrued interest and precedes the credit loss allowance; it is not fair-value carrying amount.

children.label: AFS Debt — Cost after Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: Net AFS amortized cost excludes accrued interest and already reflects credit allowance; it remains distinct from fair value.

children.label: AFS Debt Securities — Amortized Cost after Allowance

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: Amortized cost after the credit allowance differs from AFS fair-value carrying amount; distinguish accrued-interest scope from explicitly excluding-interest concepts.

children.label: AFS Credit Loss Allowances
children.classification_note: Allowance measures may differ in accrued-interest scope. Do not deduct these again from AFS fair-value carrying balances.

children.label: Debt Securities Available For Sale Allowance For Credit Loss
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: AFS credit loss allowance is a component of the measurement bridge; do not deduct it a second time from the reported fair value.

children.label: AFS Debt — Credit Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
concepts.review_reason: AFS cost-basis credit allowance excludes accrued interest; its scope may differ from a general AFS credit allowance.

children.label: HTM Before-Allowance Measurements
children.classification_note: Before-allowance HTM amounts are gross measurement disclosures; carrying balances after allowance appear in assets.

children.label: HTM Debt before Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: Gross HTM amount excludes accrued interest and precedes credit allowance; do not substitute for the net carrying balance.

children.label: HTM Credit Loss Allowances
children.classification_note: Total and accrued-interest-excluding allowances overlap and reconcile to corresponding gross/net HTM amounts only when scopes match.

children.label: Debt Securities Held To Maturity Allowance For Credit Loss
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: HTM credit allowance is a deduction used in gross-to-net reconciliation, not an additional HTM asset.

children.label: HTM Debt — Credit Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
concepts.review_reason: HTM allowance excluding accrued interest must match an equally scoped gross balance; it can overlap the general HTM allowance.

children.label: Combined Cash and Federal Funds Sold
children.classification_note: Overlaps cash and federal funds sold; do not use as a cash-only balance.

children.label: Cash Cash Equivalents And Federal Funds Sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsAndFederalFundsSold
concepts.review_reason: Combines cash, cash equivalents and federal funds sold; overlaps both cash-only aggregates and separately reported federal funds sold.

children.label: Asset Gross Balances and Accumulated Depreciation
children.classification_note: Gross core-deposit intangibles and accumulated depreciation/amortization are measurement details already reflected in corresponding net assets.

children.label: PP&E — Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine the reported sign and presentation adjustment from the fact context. Never negate automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Accumulated property depreciation, depletion and amortization is already deducted in net property, plant and equipment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedCoreDepositsGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross core-deposit intangible amount precedes amortization and impairment and must not replace a net intangible balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Accumulated deduction associated with finite-lived intangible assets; already reflected in net intangible carrying values.

children.label: Debt Terms, Branch Advances and Financing Costs
children.classification_note: FHLB branch balances and one-year contractual maturities overlap total advances. Pledged collateral measures assets supporting debt, not debt itself.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBBankAmountOfAdvancesByBranch
concepts.review_reason: FHLB advances by branch are a dimensional breakdown of advances; aggregate only disjoint branches within the same reporting scope.

children.label: FHLB Advances — Contractual Maturities within One Year

concepts.name: us-gaap:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSummaryDueWithinOneYearOfBalanceSheetDate
concepts.review_reason: Contractual advances due within one year are maturity detail and may differ from recognized current carrying amount because of measurement adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtObligationsDisclosuresCollateralPledged1
concepts.review_reason: Measures collateral supporting FHLB advances, not the amount borrowed; pledged assets can remain recognized in their original asset categories.

children.label: Share Counts, Par Values and Preferred Stock Terms
children.classification_note: Share counts and contractual per-share terms are separate nonmonetary disclosures; neither category can be added to monetary equity.

children.label: Equity and ESOP Share Counts
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued, outstanding, treasury, suspense and nonvested shares describe different populations; none is a monetary equity balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized
concepts.review_reason: Authorized common shares are a legal issuance ceiling, not issued or outstanding shares.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued
concepts.review_reason: Issued common shares may include treasury shares and differ from shares outstanding.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding common shares exclude treasury shares; this instant count is not weighted-average shares used for EPS.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesAuthorized
concepts.review_reason: Authorized preferred shares describe issuance capacity, not outstanding preferred shares or their monetary carrying value.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesIssued
concepts.review_reason: Issued preferred shares can include shares no longer outstanding; confirm class dimensions before comparison.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred share count must be matched to the same class as any carrying-value or liquidation-preference measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonShares
concepts.review_reason: Treasury common share count is a quantity; the related monetary deduction is reported using treasury-stock value concepts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPNumberOfSuspenseShares
concepts.review_reason: Number of ESOP shares not released, committed for release or allocated to participants; not the monetary unearned ESOP equity balance.

children.label: Equity Per-Share Terms
children.classification_note: Par values, no-par face amounts and liquidation preferences are per-share contractual terms; they are not total equity carrying amounts.

children.label: Common Stock Par Or Stated Value Per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare
concepts.review_reason: Common-stock par or stated value is an amount per share, not the total common-stock carrying balance.

children.label: Preferred Stock Par Or Stated Value Per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare
concepts.review_reason: Preferred-stock par or stated value per share differs from carrying value and liquidation preference.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference
concepts.review_reason: Taxonomy defines the excess liquidation preference over par or stated value per share, not an aggregate preferred-stock liability.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockNoParValue
concepts.review_reason: Taxonomy defines face amount per share of no-par common stock, not total common equity.

children.label: Commitments and Contingencies
children.classification_note: Contractual exposure and contingent arrangements do not establish a recognized liability amount; review disclosure context and avoid adding to liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: Commitment or contingency amount does not establish recognition as a liability; inspect nature, scope and any separate provision.

children.label: Share-Based Compensation Disclosures
children.classification_note: Nonvested equity award counts are supplementary share measures, distinct from outstanding common shares and monetary employee equity adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedNumber
concepts.review_reason: Nonvested non-option equity award count is distinct from both option awards and issued common shares.
